Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nikhil - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Sharda - 67 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Aarav, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav hides behind the tree.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav thinks for a moment.]

Aarav (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
